defs.def: a room where a class of children or students is taught 教室；课堂

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: No matter what subject I’m teaching, I find ways to bring my hobbies into the classroom.
ex.t: 无论教什么科目，我都会想办法把我的爱好带进课堂。

ex.s: When I first brought my hobbies to my classroom, I was focused on how doing so would build engagement and help my students understand concepts in science.
ex.t: 最初把爱好带进课堂时，我关注的是这样做能如何提高参与度、帮助学生理解科学概念。

ex.s: Why does the author bring tires into the classroom?
ex.t: 作者为什么把轮胎带进课堂？

ex.s: “Students who are around plants perform better academically than students who are in a classroom without plants,” says Knuth.
ex.t: “身边有植物的学生，学业表现优于在没有植物的教室里的学生，”Knuth说。

ex.s: Education outside the classroom cannot be ignored.
ex.t: 课堂之外的教育不容忽视。

ex.s: On each floor, hallways stretched in four directions, leading to classrooms, laboratories, and teachers’ offices.
ex.t: 每层楼的走廊向四个方向延伸，通向教室、实验室和教师办公室。

ex.s: “Our classrooms are built with kids in mind.
ex.t: "我们的教室是为孩子们设计的。

ex.s: How does the school design the classrooms in consideration of kids’ height? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 考虑到孩子的身高，学校是如何设计教室的？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: After receiving permission from the boy's teacher, Alex Bakley, Cruse showed up at her classroom the following week.
ex.t: 在得到男孩的老师Alex Bakley的许可后， Cruse在接下来的一周出现在她的教室里。

ex.s: This work expanded my mind in ways that are impossible inside the four walls of a classroom.
ex.t: 这份工作在课堂四壁之内不可能实现的方式上拓展了我的心胸。

ex.s: One Monday morning, while the children were enjoying “free play”, I stepped to the doorway of the classroom to take a break.
ex.t: 一个周一早晨，当孩子们正享受自由玩耍时，我走到教室门口休息一下。

ex.s: “Boasting about yourself，and your best qualities,” Whaley says，“is very difficult for a child who came into the classroom not feeling confident.”
ex.t: “夸自己，夸自己的优点，”惠利说，“对一个走进教室时毫无自信的孩子来说，是非常困难的。”

ex.s: HUNCH is designed to connect high school classrooms with NASA engineers.
ex.t: HUNCH旨在将高中课堂与NASA工程师联系起来。

ex.s: Nature: An Outdoor Classroom.
ex.t: 大自然：户外教室。

ex.s: They come to camp, wanting to know what it is like to be an astronaut or a pilot, and they leave with real-world applications for what they’re studying in the classroom.
ex.t: 他们来到营地，想知道当宇航员或飞行员是什么感觉，离开时带着把课堂所学用于现实世界的实际办法。

ex.s: Today Pacific Science Center serves more than 1.3 million people a year and beings inquiry-based science education to classrooms and community events all over Washington State.
ex.t: 今天，太平洋科学中心每年为130多万人提供服务，为华盛顿州各地的教室和社区活动提供以调查为基础的科学教育。

ex.s: Take science to the classroom.
ex.t: 我的下一项工作是建造一个鸟巢并将其固定在树上。

ex.s: Just last year, I was  56  a workshop when someone knocked at the classroom door.
ex.t: 就在去年，我在一个工作坊里，这时有人敲了教室的门。

ex.s: Just last year, I was   56    a workshop when someone knocked at the classroom door.
ex.t: 就在去年，我正在____56____一个研讨会，这时有人敲教室门。

ex.s: When my English teacher stepped into the classroom, I was surprised to see the same man I had met earlier.
ex.t: 当我的英语老师走进教室时，我惊讶地发现他就是我之前遇到的那个男人。

ex.s: Here are some of our favourites, to remind us that some of the English we learn in the classroom is rather different from the English in the outside world!
ex.t: 以下是我们最喜欢的几个例子，它们提醒我们，我们在课堂上学的一些英语和外面世界里的英语相当不一样！

ex.s: School staff and student volunteers will show new students around the school, and "the new students will get their schedules and find out where their classrooms are".
ex.t: 学校工作人员和学生志愿者将向学校周围的新生展示， “新生将得到他们的时间表，并找出他们的教室在哪里”。

ex.s: I could have left it in the classroom.
ex.t: 我可以把它留在教室里。

ex.s: He looked across the classroom at the drinking fountain.
ex.t: 他望着教室对面的饮水机。
